name: 04609 · Bar Harbor, ME
findings: ZIP 04609 (Bar Harbor) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04609 (Bar Harbor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04609 (Bar Harbor) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).
